messages:
alex-peopleops: Quick thread  Mira's candidate (senior data engineer, remote EU) accepted verbally. Manager requests comp-band uplift from band6->band7 and day-one benefits effective 2026-12-01. Payroll earliest enrollment 2026-12-14. Can we approve a short retro and a cost-shift for the sign-on to hiring team budget?

mira-hiring: Candidate has competing counteroffer. Manager wants band7 to match market. Also asking that sign-on bonus be paid at first payroll but charged to hiring P&L instead of central comp for headcount flexibility.

tony-finance: Flags: Cost-shift for sign-on is doable if approved by Finance lead and tagged to cost center. Uplift delta ~£19,200 annualized; sign-on cost ~£7,500 one-time. Retro benefits backdate possible up to 14 days with CFO approval. Need explicit approval trail for audit.

elainet-talent: (typo fix) Elaine-talent: Candidate is very benefits-sensitive. If benefits don't start day-one they may rescind. Talent recommends interim vendor coverage for two weeks if payroll can't backdate.

nisha-legal: Legal: Retroactive enrollment is allowed if signed offer shows effective date and exception documented. Recommend capping retro at 14 days. For charging sign-on to hiring P&L, need manager + finance sign-off and note in offer.

alex-peopleops: Proposed route: 1) Approve provisional band7 pending CFO sign-off. 2) Approve benefits retro to start date up to 14 days. 3) Allow sign-on to be charged to hiring cost center if Finance approves and it's noted in offer. 4) Talent to arrange vendor interim coverage if payroll delay >7 days. Approve?

tony-finance: Conditional OK. I'll prepare cost memo and ping Maria-CFO. Please provide cost center code and manager approval.

mira-hiring: Manager provided cost center CC-ENG-42 and sent email approval. I'll upload signed offer once candidate signs.

elainet-talent: I'll standby to kick off vendor coverage if needed. Vendor estimate ~£80/week.

nisha-legal: Send signed offer PDF with effective 2026-12-01 to legal@redwood. Drafting exception language: "Benefits may be applied retroactively to the candidate start date, not exceeding 14 days; any one-time payroll tax adjustments to be absorbed by Finance. Sign-on bonus charged to CC-ENG-42 per Finance approval." Approve?

hr-bot: Tasks created: "prep-cost-memo" -> @tony-finance (due 2026-11-25); "issue-updated-offer" -> @alex-peopleops (due 2026-11-28); "vendor-coverage-standby" -> @elainet-talent (due 2026-12-01).

tony-finance: Maria-CFO pinged. Maria: uplift annual delta ~£19,200; sign-on ~£7,500 charged to CC-ENG-42 accepted. Approve retro benefits up to 14 days?

maria-cfo: (via DM) Reviewed. Approve band7 uplift and benefits backdate up to 14 days. Finance will accept sign-on cost on CC-ENG-42 and absorb small payroll adjustments.

tony-finance: CFO approved. Posting final: band7 uplift confirmed, retro benefits to 2026-12-01 (max 14 days), sign-on to be charged to CC-ENG-42.

mira-hiring: Candidate signed at 11:07. Uploaded signed PDF and confirmation.

hr-bot: Tasks completed: "prep-cost-memo" by @tony-finance (timestamp 1766789102); "issue-updated-offer" by @alex-peopleops (timestamp 1766789120); "vendor-coverage-standby" by @elainet-talent (timestamp 1766789130).

alex-peopleops: Finalizing exception record EXC-2026-449, issuing updated offer and routing to HR records and payroll. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
